Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device__.

Claim 14 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube.

Claim 16 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body.

Claim 17 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

Claim 18 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

Claim 20 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection.

Claim 21 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier.

Claim 22 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line.

Claim 23 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

Claim 24 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 25 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.

Claim 26 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 29 (Previously Presented): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 30 (Currently Amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Previously Presented): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 32 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device comprising: a blower to deliver a supply of pressurized air; electronic control means for controlling the delivery pressure of the blower so as to deliver CPAP therapy to a patient for the treatment of sleep-related problems; and a socket adapted to receive a connector provided to a respiratory gas tube arrangement, the socket being adapted to deliver the supply of pressurized air to the respiratory gas tube arrangement via the connector, wherein the socket includes a power supply adapted to provide electrical power to contact elements on the connector for the provision of power to a heater provided to heat the gas as it is delivered through the respiratory gas tube arrangement.

Claim 33 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device, comprising: a blower to generate a supply of pressurized air; a tube provided to the blower; and a sheathing body structured to cover the blower and the tube.

Claim 34 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device according to claim 33, wherein the blower is in the form of a cartridge.

Claim 35 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device according to claim 33, wherein the sheathing body is removably attached to the blower and the tube.

Claim 36 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device according to claim 33, wherein the sheathing body is structured to insulate the tube and/or blower.

Claim 37 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device according to claim 33, further comprising one or more additional elements coupled to the blower and tube in modular fashion and covered by the sheathing body.

Claim 38 (Withdrawn): A CPAP device according to claim 37, wherein the one or more additional elements includes a humidifier, gas analysis module, gas flow sensor, pressure lock, and tube silencer.
